note: Both sets suffer from severe misbinding, frequently attributing dimensions from the 'Floor Beam Near Grid 5' (Detail B1) to the 'Roof Beam @ Grid 6 & Near Grid 5' (Detail C1) entity. However, Set A is slightly better because it uses more accurate attribute labels for the correctly conditioned claims (e.g., 'total dimension' for the 10'-0" span in Detail A1 vs Set B's 'distance from opening to edge', and 'distance to left boundary' vs Set B's vague 'dimension segment'). Set A also has one fewer wrong claim overall.
remarks: Both extractors fail to distinguish the three distinct beam details (A1, B1, C1) based on their titles, leading to systematic misbinding of dimensions (e.g., assigning W10X15 and 4'-2" offsets to the Roof Beam which is W8X13 with 2'-6" spacing). The text layer read error 'FLOOR BEAMNEA' appears in both.
